note: OpenSCAD's official snapshot, unmodified. The app bundles the native build for Linux and Windows ("native", tools/fetch_native_engine.py); its version is the one the app records with renders and checks.

native.note: Native OpenSCAD snapshots, bundled with the desktop app (tools/fetch_native_engine.py). Linux needs libOpenGL, libEGL and libGLX from the system.
